images.description: Grand Lumière main lobby — crystal chandeliers, polished marble floors, tall arched windows with warm golden light
Grand Lumière branded welcome card — elegant lobby with hotel name and tagline
La Petite Terrasse — rooftop lounge and infinity pool at golden hour, champagne seating, panoramic city views
Bar Lumière — intimate jazz cocktail bar in the lobby, crystal chandeliers, marble counter, live jazz every evening from 6pm
Interactive 3D virtual tour of the entire hotel — guests can walk through the lobby, rooms, spa, and rooftop from their phone
